text.en: Clients consistently celebrate the styling quality at this Raheny salon, remarking that dogs leave looking immaculate, smelling fresh, and feeling super soft. Reviewers praise thorough breed trims for Westies and Pomeranians, along with careful deshedding, nail clipping, and gland maintenance. Pet parents appreciate the meticulous finish and reliably high grooming standards.

Pet owners speak warmly of Tom, highlighting his professional expertise, friendly demeanour, and clear consultation process. Clients note that he takes time to discuss individual coat requirements and allergies before starting any treatment. Reviewers praise his calm, patient manner, which creates an enjoyable and reassuring experience for owners and pets alike.

Reviewers emphasize how gently nervous pets and young puppies are handled, noting that dogs emerge relaxed and wagging their tails. Owners of timid breeds appreciate the quiet and calming atmosphere of the studio, which prevents overstimulation during washing and styling. Clients feel complete confidence leaving sensitive companion animals in Tom's caring hands.

q.en: Can the salon cater to nervous or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention that groomer Tom is exceptionally gentle and patient, helping nervous pets feel relaxed throughout.

q.en: Does WHO'S A GOOD DOG? groom young puppies for their first visit?

a.en: Yes, pet parents report excellent first grooming experiences for young puppies, including West Highland Terriers.

q.en: Are skin allergies taken into account during treatments?

a.en: Reviewers note that Tom reviews pet skin sensitivities and allergy requirements in detail during the initial consultation.

q.en: What size dogs does the Raheny salon focus on?

a.en: The studio specializes in grooming small dog breeds, offering full trims, mini grooms, and hand stripping services.
